reasoning: The question asks if 95% or more of Nigerians aged 18+ will have a bank account before 2025 (by end of 2024). As of the forecast date (October 16, 2025), this deadline has already passed. The CBN Governor set a 2024 target in July 2019, but achieving a 55+ percentage point increase (from 39.7% in 2017 to 95%) in 7 years would be extraordinarily rapid. While Nigeria has made progress in financial inclusion, reaching 95% by 2024 would require unprecedented acceleration. Most recent data suggests Nigeria's financial inclusion rate remained well below 95% through 2024. Given the resolution criteria requiring data by March 1, 2026, and the historical trajectory showing much slower progress, this almost certainly resolves negatively.
